_README: Where language-toolchain.json comes from. It is a byte-identical copy of nanohype/standards/language-toolchain.json at `upstream.ref` — never hand-edit it. The digest is verified by __tests__/standards-pin.test.ts, and `npm run standards:check` re-verifies it against upstream at that same ref. `npm run standards:sync -- <sha>` moves the pin and rewrites the digest together. See README.md in this directory.
